info.name: Get account usage, credits and hourly rate limit

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key. Optional here only because the same key may instead be sent as `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`; one of the two is required.

params.name: zero_retention
params.description: Enterprise-only. Set to `true` to disable logging and storage of the request for compliance purposes.

items.docs: Returns the authenticated key's monthly allowance, month-to-date usage, remaining credits, searches made in the current hour, the hourly rate limit, and the current subscription period. Poll this to stay inside the documented cap of 20% of the plan's monthly credits per hour.

info.name: Get aggregated search analytics for the account

params.name: engine
params.description: Filter to one engine by name, or `all` for every engine.

params.name: time_period_min
params.description: Start date or datetime of the window. Defaults to one month ago.

params.name: time_period_max
params.description: End date or datetime of the window. Defaults to today.

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key, if not supplied as an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

params.name: zero_retention
params.description: Enterprise-only. Disable logging and storage of the request.

items.docs: Retrieves and explores the account's search analytics: aggregate speed, total searches, success rate and errors, optionally broken down per engine and bucketed by day or hour over a chosen time period.
